intro.en: Custom Phoenix-interface terminal, sensor and equipment harnesses, with defined pinouts, conductor preparation and installation requirements.
intro.zh: 定制 Phoenix 接口端子、传感器及设备线束，明确针脚、导体处理及安装要求。

knowledge.en: Identify the exact terminal, circular or heavy-duty interface before defining conductor preparation, protection and test requirements.
knowledge.zh: 先识别准确的端子、圆形或重载接口，再定义导体处理、防护与检验要求。

notes.en: Provide the mating reference, wiring view, conductor range, installation environment and required approval method.
notes.zh: 提供对插料号、接线视图、导体范围、安装环境及所需认可方法。

delivery.en: Approve the interface schedule, workmanship sample and controlled inspection record before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前认可接口清单、工艺样品及受控检验记录。

subtitle.en: Interface selection, conductor preparation and controlled installation
subtitle.zh: 接口选型、导体处理与受控安装

lead.en: A controlled assembly links the exact interface to its conductor, mating equipment and operating environment.
lead.zh: 受控组件需要把准确接口与导体、对插设备及工作环境联系起来。
